answer: The cheapest real defence: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because sparrow only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, hollow is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any saffron approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
